method: 4 alternating paired rounds in a clean, non-instrumented page. Each360-step/30-draw warmup +120 measured fixed steps/15draws. Renderer ProcessTime only. Full npm test and other QA overlap; not isolated normal RAF CPU/FPS or RAM saving.
limits: Small samples and concurrent load; medians are not guaranteed improvements.
All twelve final paired framebuffer FNV1a32 + scene SHA256 matches.
First all-bones-update prototype performance excluded, retained only in ignored.data.
A single fallback hand can upload more bone bytes from shared storage; exact matrix payload/storage stays10,240bytes total.
Renderer memory.textures is native resource count, not VRAM byte count.
